pages.text: Alcubierre found a solution of general relativity that moves a bubble of flat space at any speed: space contracts ahead of it and expands behind. Its wall must be made of $(thing)negative energy$() - from $(item)Negative Energy Lattices$() of Casimir plates.

The $(item)Warp Field Forge$() shapes the bubble. Set its speed, radius and wall sharpness: the negative energy needed grows as v²R²σ, the shear across the wall as vσ (above 5 it tears a passenger apart), and a wall too thick for its bubble (Rσ < 10) leaks. A $(item)Warp Bubble Core$() must be superluminal, with under one solar mass of negative energy.
Use a Warp Bubble Core to anchor where you stand: it becomes an $(item)Anchored Warp Bubble$(). Use that, anywhere, to return there - once. Recipes only take the plain core.
